How this renders

The host reads the Marbles JSON and hands Soil one snapshot. `view` returns forms, `render-html` emits the page. A browser receives HTML and CSS only.

Next slice

`claim`, `review`, and `close` become forms that post intents back to the host. The read path stays a pure function.
